settings.question: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
settings.answer: Our minimum order quantity is 5 pieces per product.

settings.question: Can I get my logo printed on the products?
settings.answer: Yes! We offer full custom branding including logo printing and embroidery.

settings.question: How long does production take?
settings.answer: Standard: 7-10 days. Custom: 10-15 days after design approval.

settings.question: Do you offer bulk discounts?
settings.answer: Yes! Orders of 5+ pieces receive a 50% discount, applied at checkout.

settings.question: Do you ship across India?
settings.answer: Yes, we ship pan-India. Delivery takes 3-7 days after dispatch.
